kjv: lie in ambush, ambushment, lurking place, lying in wait.

occurrences.text: Joshua therefore sent them forth: and they went to lie in ambush, and abode between Beth–el and Ai, on the west side of Ai: but Joshua lodged that night among the people.
But Jeroboam caused an ambushment to come about behind them: so they were before Judah, and the ambushment was behind them.
He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
